execution_amendments.failure_reason: The isolated staging tree omitted scripts/run_official_closedloop_job.sh and other complete runtime-tree dependencies; the job exited in one second before producing a manifest, evaluator endpoint, or control frame.
execution_amendments.scientific_status: Submission/runtime packaging error with no experimental result.
execution_amendments.repair_boundary: Do not patch the staging tree piecemeal. After the final already-running clean_off job finishes, deploy only the attested frozen core files into the complete production project tree, rerun full preregistration hash attestation there, and submit one replacement clean_pairwise_trace job with the unchanged scientific condition.

execution_amendments.failure_stage: Agent setup before the first control frame
execution_amendments.triggering_observation: The log showed that the legacy DensityUQEstimator was still instantiated even though its score had no control path in clean_pairwise_trace.
execution_amendments.scientific_status: Cancelled before any control frame; no experimental result.
execution_amendments.repair_boundary: Make legacy Density UQ structurally absent in the adapter sidecar: disable construction in the model config, assert environment/model agreement in the agent, record the disable flag in the manifest, require density_uq_score to be null on every frame, re-freeze source hashes, and submit one replacement with the unchanged adapter checkpoint and no-control contract.

execution_amendments.repair_attestation: Production hash attestation, five focused tests, disabled-config loading, and wrapper dry-run all passed before submission.
execution_amendments.interim_runtime_evidence: The replacement loaded the frozen pairwise adapter with the registered SHA-256, logged legacy_density_uq=False, emitted six 10x10 camera grids on every inspected control frame, kept density_uq_score null, and kept risk mode off with zero intervention.
execution_amendments.scientific_status: Running; no endpoint interpretation is permitted until the frozen verifier passes on the complete trace.

adapter_event_diagnostic.interpretation: The adapter emitted a temporally early front-view response, but the largest approach uplift occurred in the rear-right view and its heatmap emphasized static facade/road regions rather than the collision actor. This is a mixed task-agnostic observation-evidence response, not clean task-relevant localization and not authority for learned control.

execution_amendments.decision: Retain the run as a valid no-control adapter diagnostic. Proceed only to the already-preregistered, adapter-free task-event oracle mechanism test; do not expand learned-control matrices.

scientific_question: On a native clean route where frozen ORION has a terminal collision, does the frozen Stage-1 adapter produce timely and view/spatially selective observation-evidence signals around the event without changing ORION control?

primary_route.selection_basis: Job 1086150 was a runtime-valid clean_off replay with 100 percent route completion and one official vehicle collision.
primary_route.development_boundary: The route was selected using a known clean failure and is a mechanism-development diagnostic, not held-out confirmation.

prospective_route_priority_amendment.reason: Job 1086450 subsequently produced a runtime-valid 100-percent-complete official collision whose evaluator actor exactly matched the first zero-gap trace actor in a forward crossing conflict. This geometry is better suited to both all-view observation diagnostics and a separately preregistered conservative-response upper bound than Route196's rear/side collision, where slowing may be harmful.
prospective_route_priority_amendment.boundary: Route196 remains a registered secondary diagnostic. Route197 is still development-selected and does not become held-out evidence.

control_invariance_contract.model_path: The adapter receives detached frozen EVAViT features only after ORION has produced its trajectory.
control_invariance_contract.conditioning_path: UQ inference mode none bypasses both UQ token and UQ vision-adapter conditioning.
control_invariance_contract.control_path: Risk mode off must return throttle and brake exactly equal to the base PID values and must never alter steering.
trace_checks_all_frames: density_uq_score is null because the legacy estimator is not constructed

unseen_local_glare_gate.interpretation: The checkpoint retained limited localization/ranking ability on an unseen synthetic family; this is not native external validity.

upstream_gate_status.non_override_rule: No clean Route197 heatmap, scalar uplift, or task-event oracle outcome can convert this checkpoint into a deployable learned-control signal. A new independently supervised and externally gated checkpoint is required.

required_outputs: complete control trace with observation_uq on every frame
causally calibrated 10x10 heatmap grids for all six cameras
front, rear, side-camera overlay GIFs around the official collision or minimum-TTC event
BEV GIF around the same event

diagnostic_interpretation.localized_and_early: A signal concentrated in the camera/region containing degraded or ambiguous evidence before the event supports using the adapter as a candidate observation-evidence side channel; it still does not prove task relevance or causation.
diagnostic_interpretation.global_all_view_uplift: Treat the adapter as an operational anomaly score rather than spatial observation uncertainty; do not claim localization.
diagnostic_interpretation.no_relevant_view_uplift: Classify this native event as unsupported by the current adapter and do not use its score to control this event.
diagnostic_interpretation.event_visible_and_certain: A collision despite low localized observation UQ is consistent with planning/interaction failure rather than observation uncertainty.
diagnostic_interpretation.terminal_event_not_reproduced: Keep the run as a no-control signal/false-positive diagnostic but do not compare event-window safety against job 1086150 as a paired causal result.

next_step_rule.before_any_adapter_control: The existing checkpoint has no adapter-control execution authority because its frozen native-fog gate failed. A future checkpoint must pass an independently frozen external gate in addition to runtime-valid signal diagnostics.
next_step_rule.if_supported: Use the result only to diagnose useful spatial behavior and to design the next independent supervision set; do not retrofit a governor window from adapter output.
next_step_rule.if_not_supported: Return to Stage-1 supervision/localization rather than expanding learned-control matrices.

claim_boundary: This diagnostic can show whether the frozen adapter emits a useful, non-controlling observation-evidence signal on one native failure route. It cannot show that uncertainty caused the collision, that the VLM understands uncertainty, or that uncertainty-aware control improves safety.
